templates.name: Windows DC (Example Music)
templates.description:
Companion template for the windows_dc playbook family (DC-specific health: FSMO, replication, SYSVOL, AD site registration) -- Robert's own ask since 2026-10-17, built 2026-10-26 once windows_tools_examplemusic (the generic Windows companion, which every DC also gets) existed. Shopping list built from reading every file in ansible/playbooks/windows_dc/ in full; Robert approved essentially the whole list with one explicit constraint: 'run it once per hour, don't hammer DCs doing checks' -- every live check in this template uses delay: 1h (daily for the lower-priority AD topology counts).

DESIGN NOTES
- Every PowerShell command here is copied from this repo's own real, already-proven Ansible tasks (exact property names, exact regex/failure-matching logic) -- not invented fresh. Several commands are consolidated into one system.run[] call returning JSON, with multiple DEPENDENT items extracting fields via JSONPATH, specifically to minimise the total number of live PowerShell invocations against a real DC per Robert's own instruction.
- dcdiag's hardened failure-matching regex (and the repadmin header-exclusion pattern) is the SAME fix just applied to 30-dc-replicate.yml (commit 24314f5, 2026-10-26) -- this template's own live check reuses the identical logic, not a third independent implementation of the same rule.
- Own local nodeinfo.json master item (vfs.file.contents[...,UTF-8], distinct key), NOT a cross-template reference to windows_tools_examplemusic's own master item -- confirmed 2026-10-25 that a cross-template 'templates' parent-link breaks the moment both templates are linked to the same host, which every DC here always is.
- FSMO role holders and AD topology counts are macro-gated to {$WINDOWSDC.FSMO_RELEVANT} (hub sites FAL/ODE/BRK + CLD only), mirroring 30-dc-replicate.yml's own exact gating condition -- checking forest-wide FSMO/topology state from every single DC in the forest would be redundant.
- The AD-site-registration mismatch trigger compares the LIVE Get-ADDomainController Site value against nodeinfo.json's own already-known site field -- no separate macro needed, the real expected value already exists.
- dcdiag_fail_count/dc_is_forest_root/dc_domain_name (from nodeinfo.json) are SNAPSHOTS from whenever 40-dc-summary.yml last ran (DC build/promotion time only, not routine) -- kept distinct in naming/description from this template's own live hourly dcdiag check, which is the real ongoing health signal.

NOT YET LIVE-IMPORTED OR LIVE-TESTED.

items.name: nodeinfo.json contents, DC extras (master)
items.description: Raw nodeinfo.json content -- master item for this template's own 3 DC-specific examplemusic.nodeinfo.* dependent items below (dc_is_forest_root/dc_domain_name/dcdiag_fail_count). Deliberately a SEPARATE item from windows_tools_examplemusic's own vfs.file.contents[...] master (same file, read twice -- negligible cost, a local file read), NOT a cross-template DEPENDENT reference to it -- confirmed 2026-10-25 that Zabbix refuses to link a template declaring another template as a parent to any host that ALSO links that parent template directly, which every DC here does (windows_tools_examplemusic is always-linked). The UTF-8 encoding param exists purely to give this item a distinct key from windows_tools' own bare-key item. No staleness trigger of its own -- windows_tools' own master item's nodata() trigger already covers this same file going stale, one alert, not duplicated.

items.name: nodeinfo: dc_is_forest_root
items.description: Set once at promotion time (00-dc-preflight.yml) -- a snapshot, not live-refreshed.

items.name: nodeinfo: dc_domain_name
items.description: Set once at promotion time -- a snapshot, not live-refreshed.

items.name: nodeinfo: dcdiag_fail_count (last build/summary run)
items.description: Written by 40-dc-summary.yml's own dcdiag run, which only runs during DC build/promotion, NOT routinely -- this is a SNAPSHOT from whenever that last happened, not a live ongoing check. See the separate live hourly dcdiag item below for the real, continuously-refreshed health signal.

items.name: dcdiag failure count (replications/dns/fsmo/netlogons)
items.key: system.run[powershell -command "$o = dcdiag /test:replications /test:dns /test:fsmo /test:netlogons 2>&1; $a = ($o | Select-String -Pattern 'failed test' -CaseSensitive:$false).Count; $b = ($o | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch '^\s*warning:'} | Select-String -Pattern 'error' -CaseSensitive:$false).Count; Write-Output ($a + $b)",wait]
items.description: Live hourly check, same hardened failure-matching logic as 40-dc-summary.yml/30-dc-replicate.yml's own Ansible tasks (2026-10-10/2026-10-26 fixes) -- matches dcdiag's own real 'failed test <Name>' phrase, plus a dedicated error check excluding Warning:-prefixed lines, avoiding the common benign 'Warning: Failed to add the test record...' false positive.

triggers.expression: last(/Windows DC (Example Music)/system.run[powershell -command "$o = dcdiag /test:replications /test:dns /test:fsmo /test:netlogons 2>&1; $a = ($o | Select-String -Pattern 'failed test' -CaseSensitive:$false).Count; $b = ($o | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch '^\s*warning:'} | Select-String -Pattern 'error' -CaseSensitive:$false).Count; Write-Output ($a + $b)",wait])<>0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — dcdiag failure count (replications/dns/fsmo/netlogons)
triggers.description: Live hourly check, same hardened failure-matching logic as 40-dc-summary.yml/30-dc-replicate.yml's own Ansible tasks (2026-10-10/2026-10-26 fixes) -- matches dcdiag's own real 'failed test <Name>' phrase, plus a dedicated error check excluding Warning:-prefixed lines, avoiding the common benign 'Warning: Failed to add the test record...' false positive.

items.name: repadmin /showrepl error count
items.description: Live hourly check, same error-matching pattern 30-dc-replicate.yml's own '[Stage 0] Check for repadmin errors' task already uses.

triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — repadmin /showrepl error count
triggers.description: Live hourly check, same error-matching pattern 30-dc-replicate.yml's own '[Stage 0] Check for repadmin errors' task already uses.

items.name: repadmin /replsummary error count
items.description: Live hourly check, same header-exclusion logic 30-dc-replicate.yml's own Stage 3 replication-summary task already uses -- repadmin's own column headers ('Fails/Total %', 'largest delta... error') would otherwise self-match.

triggers.expression: last(/Windows DC (Example Music)/system.run[powershell -command "$o = repadmin /replsummary 2>&1; ($o | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch 'largest delta'} | Select-String -Pattern 'fail|error' -CaseSensitive:$false).Count",wait])<>0
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — repadmin /replsummary error count
triggers.description: Live hourly check, same header-exclusion logic 30-dc-replicate.yml's own Stage 3 replication-summary task already uses -- repadmin's own column headers ('Fails/Total %', 'largest delta... error') would otherwise self-match.

items.name: DNS SRV record (_ldap._tcp) targets this DC
items.key: system.run[powershell -command "$srv = Resolve-DnsName -Name ('_ldap._tcp.' + '{$WINDOWSDC.DOMAIN_NAME}') -Type SRV -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($srv -and ($srv.NameTarget -like ($env:COMPUTERNAME + '*'))) { 'OK' } else { 'MISSING' }",wait]
items.description: Same real check as 40-dc-summary.yml's own 'Check _ldap._tcp SRV record exists for this DC' task (Resolve-DnsName -Type SRV, filtered on NameTarget). {$WINDOWSDC.DOMAIN_NAME} default matches this estate's one real forest domain (jukebox.internal).

triggers.expression: last(/Windows DC (Example Music)/system.run[powershell -command "$srv = Resolve-DnsName -Name ('_ldap._tcp.' + '{$WINDOWSDC.DOMAIN_NAME}') -Type SRV -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($srv -and ($srv.NameTarget -like ($env:COMPUTERNAME + '*'))) { 'OK' } else { 'MISSING' }",wait])<>"OK"
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — no DNS SRV record pointing at this DC
triggers.description: This DC's own SRV record should resolve and target itself.

items.name: SYSVOL and NETLOGON shares present
items.key: system.run[powershell -command "$s = Get-SmbShare | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; if (($s -contains 'SYSVOL') -and ($s -contains 'NETLOGON')) { 'OK' } else { 'MISSING' }",wait]
items.description: Same real check as 30-dc-replicate.yml's own 'Wait for SYSVOL share to appear' task (Get-SmbShare).

triggers.expression: last(/Windows DC (Example Music)/system.run[powershell -command "$s = Get-SmbShare | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; if (($s -contains 'SYSVOL') -and ($s -contains 'NETLOGON')) { 'OK' } else { 'MISSING' }",wait])<>"OK"
triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — SYSVOL or NETLOGON share missing
triggers.description: Both shares should always be present on a healthy, promoted DC.

items.name: SYSVOL Policies directory child count
items.description: Native vfs.dir.count[] -- no shell-out needed. Same real path 40-dc-summary.yml's own 'Check SYSVOL has at least one GPO' task checks (C:\Windows\SYSVOL\sysvol\<domain>\Policies).

triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — SYSVOL Policies directory is empty
triggers.description: Every real domain always has at least the Default Domain/Domain Controllers GPOs.

items.name: DC info (Site/IsGC/IsReadOnly/IPv4/OSVersion/Domain) (master)
items.description: Same real PowerShell + exact JSON property names as 40-dc-summary.yml's own 'Collect DC info' task (Get-ADDomainController). One call, several dependent items below -- avoids repeating this query once per field.

items.name: DC AD site registration
items.description: Compared below against nodeinfo.json's own site field -- no separate macro needed, the real expected value already lives in nodeinfo.

triggers.name: Hey! {HOST.NAME} — AD site registration doesn't match its real site
triggers.description: Live AD Sites-and-Services registration should match this host's own hostname-derived site (nodeinfo.json's site field).

items.name: nodeinfo: site (comparison target)
items.description: Same field windows_tools_examplemusic's own nodeinfo.site item exposes -- duplicated here locally only so this template's own site-mismatch trigger doesn't need a cross-template reference (same 2026-10-25 constraint as the master item itself).

items.name: Windows Features for AD-DS (master)
items.description: No native Zabbix item exists for Windows Features (confirmed against the real 7.0 docs, same finding as windows_tools_examplemusic's own RSAT checks). One call, 6 dependent items below.

items.name: FSMO role holders (master, hub sites + CLD only)
items.description: Same real PowerShell + exact property names as 30-dc-replicate.yml's own 'Query FSMO role holders' task (Get-ADForest/Get-ADDomain), with each holder trimmed to its short hostname (.Split('.')[0]) for a clean comparison against {HOST.NAME}. Macro-gated to {$WINDOWSDC.FSMO_RELEVANT}="yes" -- same per-host override pattern as every other hypervisor/chassis-conditional macro in this series, default "no", set "yes" on the real hub-site DCs (FAL/ODE/BRK) and CLD (the forest root), matching 30-dc-replicate.yml's own 'host_site in hub_sites or == CLD' gate exactly.

items.name: AD Sites topology counts (master, hub sites + CLD only)
items.description: Forest-wide audit state (Get-ADReplicationSite/Subnet/SiteLink, same cmdlets 30-dc-replicate.yml's own Topology Summary task uses) -- not real per-host health, so daily not hourly, and macro-gated to the same {$WINDOWSDC.FSMO_RELEVANT} hub set rather than polled identically from every DC in the forest.

macros.description: Whether this DC is a real FSMO-relevant hub site (FAL/ODE/BRK) or CLD (the forest root) -- matches 30-dc-replicate.yml's own "host_site in hub_sites or == 'CLD'" gate exactly. Default "no"; override to "yes" on the real FAL/ODE/BRK/CLD DCs only. Gates both the FSMO role items and the AD topology count items (no need to poll forest-wide topology from every DC).

This estate's one real AD forest domain. Fixed/estate-wide, not expected to vary per host -- a macro here (rather than a literal) purely so a future second forest, if one's ever stood up, doesn't need hand-editing every item key.

Item-key namespace prefix for this template's own custom DEPENDENT item keys (FSMO/features/DC-info) -- Robert's standing instruction (2026-10-25): never hardcode a namespace literal directly in an item key, always via a macro, so it can be found/changed by a harness instead of grepping scattered literals. Same reasoning as {$NODEINFO.KEY_PREFIX}, just this template's own separate namespace.
